# speechmatics

An R client for the [Speechmatics](https://www.speechmatics.com/)
speech-to-text API.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("thisisnic/speechmatics")
```

## Setup

Set your API key as an environment variable:

``` r

Sys.setenv(SPEECHMATICS_API_KEY = "your-key-here")
```

Or add it to your `.Renviron`:

    SPEECHMATICS_API_KEY=your-key-here

## Usage

``` r

library(speechmatics)

# Transcribe an audio file (writes `./testrecording.txt`)
audio <- system.file("extdata", "testrecording.mp3", package = "speechmatics")
sm_transcribe(audio)

# Specify output path
sm_transcribe(audio, "output.txt")

# Enhanced quality with speaker diarization
sm_transcribe(
  audio,
  config = sm_transcription_config(
    quality = "enhanced",
    diarization = sm_diarize_speaker()
  )
)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`sm_delete_job()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_delete_job.md)
  : Delete a job
- [`sm_diarize_channel()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_diarize_channel.md)
  : Configure channel diarization
- [`sm_diarize_speaker()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_diarize_speaker.md)
  : Configure speaker diarization
- [`sm_get_transcript()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_get_transcript.md)
  : Get transcript for a completed job
- [`sm_list_jobs()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_list_jobs.md)
  : List all jobs
- [`sm_transcribe()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_transcribe.md)
  : Transcribe an audio file
- [`sm_transcription_config()`](https://thisisnic.github.io/speechmatics/reference/sm_transcription_config.md)
  : Build transcription config
